subject: Tax forms and invoice routing for pilot services
messages:
From: Megan Castillo <megan.castillo@aperturehealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts.payable@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tax forms and invoice routing for pilot services

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get the pilot started. A couple of items our AP team needs to process the first invoice (Invoice #8721) and set up your vendor profile: 

- Can you provide a completed W-9 (PDF) with the legal entity name you want on invoices? Please confirm the EIN exactly as it should appear.
- Confirm whether Redwood Inference is an entity that should receive a 1099 (we need classification: C-Corp / S-Corp / Sole Prop / LLC treated as) for U.S. tax reporting.
- Please confirm remit address for paper checks if required, and whether you prefer ACH (if so, instructions or a secure portal for bank details).
- If Redwood has a tax residency or foreign entity variant (W-8BEN-E), let us know — we have foreign vendor processing rules.

AP also asked whether you have a signed vendor addendum or vendor profile we should store. If you can attach the W-9 and vendor profile, we can push payment on the next cycle. 

For reference: Invoice #8721 (attached) — net 45.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — can you loop in your AP contact?

Best,
Megan Castillo
Head of Procurement (Pilot Programs)
Aperture Health, Inc.
megan.castillo@aperturehealth.com

Attachment: Invoice_8721_Pilot.pdf

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Megan Castillo <megan.castillo@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Accounts Payable <accounts.payable@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tax forms and invoice routing for pilot services

Megan —

Thanks for the note and the invoice. Quick answers in-line: 

- Legal entity for invoicing: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789 (please confirm that format is acceptable for your system).
- Tax classification: C-Corporation (should be 1099-exempt in most cases). If you have an automated validator that still flags us, let me know and we can provide corporate articles.
- Remit address (paper checks): Redwood Inference, Inc., 2700 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94114 (we prefer ACH).

I attached a signed W-9 via DocuSign (envelope env-0a1b2c3d) and a brief vendor profile for your records. For security we do not email full bank credentials; I can send ACH instructions through your secure vendor portal or via your AP team's secure upload link.

Marissa (cc) — can you confirm the attached W-9 + vendor profile and share our vendor code once created?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_W9_signed.pdf (DocuSign), Redwood_vendor_profile_form.pdf

From: Megan Castillo <megan.castillo@aperturehealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts.payable@aperturehealth.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tax forms and invoice routing for pilot services

Jonas —

Appreciate the fast reply and the DocuSign envelope — that should be fine. A couple of follow-ups from AP: 

- Our system requires the EIN to match the name on the W-9 exactly. We will validate via the IRS TIN matching process; if there is any discrepancy it can delay payment.
- For larger pilots we collect a beneficial ownership attestation (simple checklist). Can you confirm Redwood does not meet the criteria for additional beneficial owner onboarding?
- Please either upload ACH instructions to our vendor portal (https://vendors.aperturehealth.com/upload) or let me know a secure channel your AP prefers. Email attachments with bank routing are not accepted.

Once we receive the W-9 and vendor profile in the portal we'll route Invoice #8721 for net-45 payment. If the TIN validation fails we'll reach back out — worst case we may need a copy of the Certificate of Formation or an IRS CP 575.

Thanks — I’ll ping AP to watch for your upload.

Best,
Megan
